"The Light alone does not make one a Guardian," Ikora says warmly as you approach. "Dedication, bravery, the will to protect those who can't protect themselves… they are what define us. And you are a shining example of them all. Thank you."
You were unable to access the memory linked to the worm statue. Ikora asks you to return to Mars to discuss what happened.

Ikora reckons with the revelation that she may be partly responsible for Savathûn's theft of the Light. But with the news that Savathûn also intends to pull the Traveler into her throne world and seal it away, there is no time to lose. She sends you to Fynch to follow up on another lead.
A trusted source has informed Eris of an artifact in Savathûn's throne world that might hold the answer to how she acquired the Light. Eris wants you to infiltrate Savathûn's fortress and find it.
Fynch believes there might be an important artifact hidden in Savathûn's temple to Oryx. He's offered to help you reach the temple and find out.
As you speak, the ritual is already beginning. Complete "The Ritual" mission in the Throne World.
Ikora wants you to follow up on a tip from Fynch. He believes there may be another important artifact hidden in a dangerous area of Savathûn's throne world.

Ikora believes that strengthening your connection to Darkness will improve your Deepsight ability, allowing you to "read" the memory associated with Sagira's shell. The Pyramid on Europa might grant you the power you seek.
When you found Sagira's shell, you heard an echo of Savathûn's voice, speaking about something called the "Witness." Ikora awaits you on Mars to discuss what you heard.
The Hidden have identified an area in Savathûn's throne world that might allow you to access the memory tied to Sagira's shell. Ikora has sent you to investigate.
With Savathûn dead, Ikora wants your help answering some lingering questions about the Witness. Queen Mara Sov has requested your presence, and Ikora believes she has vital information to share.

Ikora believes the worm statue you found before may not be a statue at all, but instead the calcified corpse of the worm itself. The memory locked within is ancient — too ancient to reveal by normal means. But Ikora has a plan, and it involves the Relic.
Ikora has a theory about how to stop Savathûn from stealing the Traveler, but she needs your help.
The last memory you saw revealed that Savathûn was chosen by the Traveler, the same as any Guardian. You should consult the Vanguard about this shocking revelation.
You acquired a piece of the crystal prison that held Savathûn before she acquired the Light. This fragment might hold a memory that explains what happened.
Savathûn is defeated, but her throne world is still swarming with enemies, and the Witness is still at large. Ikora wishes to speak with you about the work yet to be done.
When Ikora unlocked the memory tied to Savathûn's worm familiar, she discovered the proto-Hive were tricked by the Witness. This information might be the key to stopping Savathûn.

Ikora believes Savathûn can be stopped by showing her the memory of how she and her siblings were tricked by the Witness. Her ritual to steal the Traveler has already begun, so there's no time to lose.

Ikora explains that there's a final step to accessing the memory linked to Sagira's shell. You need to locate a concentration of psychic energy that will help manifest the memory. The Hidden have identified such a location in Savathûn's throne world.

With Fynch's help, you acquired a piece of Oryx's Tablets of Ruin. If you bring the Tablet to the Altar of Reflection, you may be able to witness another of Savathûn's memories. Return to the Altar in Witch's Echo.

Ikora believes that when you picked up Sagira's shell, you heard a fragment of a memory belonging to Savathûn. Your interaction with the Relic unlocked a new ability in you, one related to Darkness. She believes you can strengthen this ability at the Europan Pyramid, and in doing so, gain access to the full memory linked to Sagira's shell.

With Fynch's help, you recovered a strange artifact: a statue of the worm familiar that spoke to Savathûn before she and her siblings became the Hive. This no doubt holds an important memory from her early life.
After witnessing two of Savathûn's memories, one of which detailed her plan to steal the Traveler from our sky, it's time to return to Ikora with your findings.
As a reward for completing the Legendary Campaign, you have received powerful gear to help in the battles to come.
Fynch is excited to hear of our progress and lets us in on another lead.
Hidden in the Throne World is a monument to Savathûn's brother, Oryx. Fynch believes that location might hold more information about how Savathûn acquired the Light.
You visited the Pyramid on Europa to strengthen your connection to Darkness. Before you return to Savathûn's throne world, Ikora wants to speak with you about Sagira's shell.
The rebel Hive Ghost, Fynch, knows the location of a Hive temple that might hold useful information about Savathûn. Although he's wary of you, he's agreed to help you infiltrate it.
You have completed the Legendary campaign. Please select your reward.

You saw a memory where Savathûn, disguised as Osiris, may have tricked Ikora into revealing information about the Light. Before you speak to Ikora about it, however, Fynch has an important lead to share.
Complete "The Cunning" mission in the Throne World.
Meet Mara Sov, Queen of the Awoken, near the Relic.
Meet Ikora on Mars.
Complete "The Ghosts" mission.
Complete "The Cunning" mission.
Complete "The Mirror" mission.
Complete "The Lightblade" strike.
Complete "The Mirror" mission in the Throne World.
Complete "The Lightblade" strike in the Throne World.
Complete "The Ritual" mission.
Complete "The Last Chance" mission.
The Witness undoubtedly seeks a second Collapse. If we are not prepared for its arrival, we will fall again… this time, for good.
lines.speaker: Ikora

lines.text: A curse? Killing Sav's worm? Yeah, okay, I think I can maybe help with that! Take this casing—it's enchanted with all sorts of Hive magics. Could be your solution!
lines.speaker: Fynch

lines.text: Savathûn's dormant curse is now killing her worm! You'll need to act fast to keep it alive before you can start looking for Mara.
With Savathûn taken care of, Mara Sov has arrived to help us acquire knowledge in preparation for The Witness.
You have what you need to begin revitalizing Savathûn's worm. In the meantime, Mara has located another incubator in the Sepulcher Lost Sector.
Fynch has transmitted details of a Cryptoglyph rune location. Track it down to re-energize the Cryptoglyph once more.
The Sepulcher Lost Sector awaits you somewhere within the Florescent Canal.
Mara has asked that you take Savathûn's dying worm into the Throne World and find a way to revitalize it.
Fynch has pointed you in the general direction of another rune. Canvas the area and gather leads.
The casing provided by Fynch may save Savathûn's worm, but you'll need to find a way to combine the two. Seek energy to sustain the worm in the meantime.
The Metamorphosis Lost Sector awaits you somewhere within the Miasma.
You have what you need to continue revitalizing Savathûn's worm. Mara has located another incubator, this time in the Metamorphosis Lost Sector.
The rune was stolen and stashed away before you could get to it. Seek out the nearby Deepsight cache to retrieve it.
Mara believes that truths about The Witness and our Collapse lie within the mind of Savathûn's dying worm.
In order to learn what it knows, you and Mara must first revitalize it.
The rune has been drained of its power. Recharge it by defeating Scorn in the Throne World.
The Extraction Lost Sector awaits you somewhere within Quagmire.
Fynch has transmitted details of a Cryptoglyph rune location. Track it down to re-energize the Cryptoglyph.
Visit Mara Sov in the Enclave on Mars.
Visit Fynch.
Travel to the Temple of the Cunning to locate a Cryptoglyph Rune.
Understand advanced and technical concepts in the Aionian language, allowing full depth of translation.
Understand most words and sentence structures in Aionian, allowing for a greater range of linguistic interfacing with Aionian devices and ciphers.
Understand basic words and concepts in Aionian, allowing for a greater range of linguistic interfacing with Aionian devices and ciphers.
Decipher Aionian characters, allowing interfacing with Aionian devices and ciphers.
Complete mission "//node.ovrd.AVALON//" on Normal to unlock
Investigate a Vex network node in the EDZ that has been overwritten with a single word: AVALON.
The Taken's shield draws power from a nearby pylon.
Wizards channel a restorative ritual over the Monstrosity.
Purchase the Season Pass to unlock this challenge.
Defeat the Taken Monstrosity.
Defeat the Taken Will of Quria.
Defeat the Taken Howler.
Defeat the Taken Pyromaster.
Clear Taken Blockers.
Complete sections of the Nether and defeat bosses, consume Sigil Stones, and turn in Metastasized Essentia to increase mastery of your chosen path.
Found in the arms of a statue at the base of the waterfalls in the Altars of Summoning.
Found behind the suspended elemental runes at the end of the Labyrinth in Savathûn's Spire.
Found during Week 5 of "The Bladed Path" quest.
Contains gear from Season of the Witch. Can be focused and decrypted at the Ritual Table.
Found atop the pillar in the Altar of Feracity in the Altars of Summoning.
Used to obtain additional loot from chests in Savathûn's Spire and the Altars of Summoning.
A cache of Offerings used to cast rituals in the Altars of Summoning.
"The Pyramid wastes no time—a phantom of Toland has arrived with every intention of distracting me. It will not work."
"The phantom of Eriana-3 now haunts me alongside the rest. They are a burden that weighs heavy on my mind."
"A phantom of my deceased fireteam member Sai Mota haunts me. It is only a trick of the Pyramid."
"It appears the screams of Sai's phantom have brought forth another burden for me to bear—the phantom of Vell Tarlowe."
"It is no surprise that the Pyramid now inflicts the phantom of Omar Agah upon me. The Pyramid will do anything to stop us from getting inside."

Your discoveries within the Pyramid are key to the future and survival of all—but the Nightmares continue their attack across the entire system, beyond our Moon. They must not be allowed to spread any further.
Stay vigilant. Keep Nightmares at bay on every planet.

During Eris's time in the Hellmouth, she discovered many Hive curios. All that remained was an ancient talisman pulsating with Hive magic. Now, the union between the talisman and the Essence of Despair has yielded a powerful tool in the fight against the Nightmares.
The Cryptoglyph must be used to empower the Lectern of Enchantment near Eris. In tandem with the cleansed Essence of Anguish, this will yield another piece of Dreambane armor.
Empower the Lectern of Enchantment with the Cryptoglyph before setting off to hunt the remaining Nightmares.
More Nightmare Essences are required to craft the remaining three pieces of Dreambane armor.
No need to waver, Guardian. The Vanguard stands behind you every step of the way.
The Light is our strength. The Darkness will never take that from us.
From the Nightmare of Crota, you received an unknown object that harbors a dark energy. You leave it with Eris Morn so she can unearth its secrets.
In the meantime, the Moon hosts further mysteries to uncover regarding entering the Pyramid. The Hive seem to be exhibiting strange behavior that may be related.

As the Nightmare of Omnigul swept through camp, Eris noticed a strange reaction from the Essence of Despair. Upon further investigation, it appears the Essence can be of use in fighting these Nightmares. But first, it must be cleansed of any dark energy.
You have acquired further Nightmare Essences but are out of Hive curios with which to create more Dreambane armor.

After discovering the Hive's ability to shield themselves from the Nightmares, Eris learned of a dark power possessed by the Hive inside the Scarlet Keep. This power may be our answer to how they've protected themselves—and our key to creating more Dreambane armor.
Hashladûn has been disposed of, and with her death comes a path to victory: the Hive Cryptoglyph.

You now stand at the precipice of the future. The Pyramid holds many secrets within. Lift the veil, and find a way inside. Look for something within—anything that might help humanity fight the oncoming storm.
The Lectern of Enchantment glows with the magic of the Hive thanks to its newly affixed power source, the Cryptoglyph.
The Lectern of Enchantment can now alter Cleansed Nightmare Essences to create more Dreambane armor.
Eris believes that whatever these things are, they want nothing more than to destroy everything we hold dear.
Eris takes the Unknown Artifact from you. She desires to study it in hopes of making sense of all that you saw within the Pyramid.
Take this piece of Dreambane armor and use it to hunt the Nightmare of Omnigul.
Equip Dreambane armor mods to enhance your power within this mission.
Complete the quest "Essence of Despair."
Take the Essence of Despair and purify it any way you can. Then, return to Eris Morn.
Investigate the dark power within the Scarlet Keep.
Travel to the Hellmouth and locate the Catacombs within. Hashladûn's Cryptoglyph lies inside for the taking.
Return to the Enduring Abyss with a full set of Dreambane armor equipped, and find a way inside the Pyramid.
Traverse a treacherous cave full of deadly moths.
Soar through the air without touching the ground.
Slay an unstoppable giant and end its brutal ritual.
Take up a Sword and carve your way through the Hive.
"These Fallen sure know how to keep us on our toes."
Your journey towards mastering Stasis continues. Attune your Splinter, now enhanced by the one you retrieved from Praksis, once more at the Ziggurat.
A black pyramidal object that fits in your hand and hums with a soothing energy.
Variks is alarmed to hear about Eramis's lieutenants using Stasis. The situation is more dire than he realized.

He wants to remain on Europa in order to help other Eliksni who wish to flee Eramis, and asks you to help set up a comms network using a nearby array. That way, he can communicate with his allies and prepare for evacuation.

According to Shaw Han, Eramis's sergeant Bakris is still in the Cosmodrome to ensure recruitment to the army of House Salvation. Shaw reports evidence of Stasis recently found in The Divide, not far from an old Devils hideout.
Variks is surprised and impressed that you managed to defeat Phylaks. He now believes you may be capable of wielding Stasis without being corrupted.

He tells you that your next target is Praksis, the Eliksni who created the technology that allows House Salvation to wield Darkness. Defeat him and Eramis's plans will come to a halt. Variks believes he's been experimenting on the Vex, and if you disrupt his experiments, you might get his attention.
The next lesson is that of control. In order to wield Stasis effectively, it must become an extension of your will.
Discipline your mind, and you'll make this dark power yours, instead of the other way around.

The next Crux is located in the heart of House Salvation's territory. The enemies you face there will attack with the rage of the affronted. Focus your abilities with firm resolve so that the battle plays out exactly as you see fit.
An enhanced Splinter of Darkness that allows you to pursue your journey beyond Light.
Zavala has requested your presence at the Tower to congratulate you on defeating Eramis and discuss your further usage of Stasis.
With your control of Stasis stronger than ever, you're finally ready to take on Eramis.
According to Zavala, Eramis has left Europa to reconnect with the House of Devils on Earth. He sends you to Shaw Han, a Guardian patrolling the Cosmodrome, for more details on this new intel.
A new Fallen leader resides on Europa, building an empire out of Darkness. This new Kell, Eramis, must be stopped before she gets any stronger.
The Splinter of Darkness pulses in attunement with the Ziggurat. The first lesson is that of acceptance. Be bold and open your mind and body to the possibilities of this new power.
Now that you've accepted this weighty responsibility, find your way to a Crux of Darkness. Commune with it. It will give you a taste of what lies ahead on this path.
The Stasis-sealed chest you unlocked contained an interesting piece of armor. Bring it to Variks so he can examine it for you.

Now that you understand how useful this power can be, you should keep an eye out for more Stasis Seals. By breaking them open, you can obtain valuable equipment and destabilize House Salvation even further.

It's time to demonstrate your newfound skills in a much more impactful way. The Exo Stranger mentioned the members of Eramis's dark council each hold their own Splinters of Darkness. Variks will know where to find them.
Shaw's suspicions are confirmed: the Devils have agreed to join Eramis's army on Europa. To make matters worse, they'll be bringing along a battalion of Walkers.

Fortunately, transporting this kind of weaponry is no simple task. At present, Eramis's sergeant Bakris convenes with the former Devils in their hideout in The Divide. There's still time to show them that even with Stasis, House Salvation is no match for the Guardians.
The time has come for the Exo Stranger to reveal to you her secret.

In another timeline, her original timeline, she failed to stop the Darkness from manipulating Guardians and bringing about a second Collapse. Since then, she has been carried through time, trying again and again to prevent that dark future.

Looking at you now, she finally sees a future in which she might succeed. She thanks you, then reminds you that the fight has only just begun. More Guardians must take this path towards Stasis. She'll be here to guide those that do.

Keep up the fight against House Salvation and all the other enemies of the Traveler. And don't forget: you have an ally in the Exo Stranger. Return here to learn more about her past and any other secrets that may help you on your journey.
You've nearly reached the end of your journey. Attune your Splinter at the Ziggurat for the final time.

Variks tells you about Eramis, a new Kell of the Fallen, or the Eliksni, as they call themselves. Through communing with Pyramids, she has managed to harness the power of Darkness and use it as a weapon.
Variks escaped with proof of that Dark power, asking for help. If Eramis succeeds in giving this power to all of her Eliksni followers, nothing, not even the Guardians, will be able to defeat her.
Variks asks you to find Eramis immediately. Perhaps she can still be stopped.
Pursue Eramis, Kell of Darkness. Complete "The New Kell" mission.
The Exo Stranger is thrilled. Your progress with Stasis marks a new milestone for her.

In order to understand why, you must know what happened in her original timeline, one in which the Darkness corrupted all but a few Guardians. When this ushered in a second Collapse, the Exo Stranger thought all hope was lost. But looking at you now, she finds hope once again. Hope in a future in which the Darkness within us all can be accepted, controlled, and embraced. A future in which balance and truth can prevail for the good of humanity.
To take one more step towards this future, the Stranger asks you to approach the Ziggurat once more and embrace the Darkness within.
Hunt down and defeat Praksis, The Technocrat to cripple Eramis's empire.
Shaw tells you that Eramis has been trying to recruit her old comrades from the former House of Devils for a while; for her to arrive in person now must mean she's growing desperate.

Word is, she brought along a trusted sergeant, Bakris, the Adamantine, and empowered her with Stasis as a demonstration of the forces at her disposal. Shaw suspects the sergeant has remained in the Cosmodrome in order to ensure the Devils follow through on their pledge to relocate to Europa.

By reactivating the Vex portal built by Clovis Bray, Eramis endangered all life on Europa, including her own soldiers' lives. Though you successfully thinned the Vex hordes, Eramis was still able to collect the radiolarian fluid she needed and escape.

What she plans to do with this resource is not yet clear. What is clear is that the Darkness has fueled her anger into a reckless rage. She must be stopped once and for all. The time has come to complete your journey with Stasis.
Stasis is now yours to wield whenever you desire.
The Exo Stranger has given you a Splinter of Darkness and pointed you towards the newly arrived Ziggurat. Go to it and begin your journey towards mastering Stasis.
Hunt down and defeat Phylaks, the Warrior to strike a major blow to Eramis's empire.

The Splinter of Darkness pulses in attunement with the Ziggurat. The second lesson is that of resistance. Be mindful. Guard your emotions against the temptations of the Darkness as well as your own fear in wielding it. This will help you resist any attack on or off the battlefield. Put that into practice when you find the next Crux.
Though her recruitment scheme has been thwarted, Eramis has another ace up her sleeve back on Europa.
Eramis plans on reactivating a long dormant Clovis Bray facility by powering up a Vex portal.
Stop her before she reactivates the portal and unleashes the Vex, endangering all life on Europa.

You've defeated Phylaks and disrupted House Salvation's attempt to claim Vex territory. In return, you gained Phylaks's Splinter of Darkness. Bring it to the Exo Stranger. It may be useful in your journey towards mastering Stasis.

The Exo Stranger has returned, just as the Darkness was inviting you in. Instead of warning you to turn back, she says it's time to accept what it offers. The Light is not enough to face Eramis and her dark council. If you want to defeat them, you must embrace the power of Darkness as they have.

She hands you a "Splinter of Darkness." This will allow you to wield Stasis. There are others like it, all in the hands of House Salvation. Yours is weak now, but it will strengthen as your proficiency grows.
Lastly, the Exo Stranger offers you her campsite. As you collect lessons and keepsakes, return here to reflect on your experiences.
But first, you must accept the path before you. Begin by attuning your Splinter in the monolithic Ziggurat on the icy flats ahead.
Hunt down and defeat Eramis, Kell of Darkness to put an end to her reign of terror.
With Eramis's undefeatable power of Stasis in the way, Variks asks for your help. Many fellow Eliksni desire to break out from the grips of House Salvation.

You retrieved a Splinter of Darkness after defeating another member of Eramis's dark council, Praksis. Bring it to the Exo Stranger to enhance your own Splinter and continue your journey in mastering Stasis.
Variks is safe from the attacking Fallen for now. It's time to get some answers.
An enhanced Splinter of Darkness that allows you to further pursue your journey beyond Light.
Now that you've resisted the temptations of the Darkness, it's time to test your sharpened Stasis skills on the next member of Eramis's dark council.

Variks looks somber. When he witnessed Eramis releasing the Vex, he realized that she has truly lost sight of what she was fighting for. Now she has endangered everything the Eliksni have built on Europa.

As the Vex make their way across Europa and towards Riis-Reborn, Variks is planning to help some of his allies evacuate the city. They are carrying an important asset that he claims will be invaluable to House Light on Earth. He asks for your help defending them, and then the way will be clear for you to confront Eramis.
As you were going towards the Pyramid, a strange monolith has appeared in Beyond, along with a few old friends.
The Exo Stranger enhanced your Splinter with the one you retrieved from Phylaks. Take it to the Ziggurat in order to continue down this path.
The power of Eramis and her followers is beyond your capabilities.
The Exo Stranger is thrilled. Not only did you accept the power of Stasis, you put it to use by taking down Phylaks and retrieving her Splinter of Darkness.

Continue working with Variks to track down the next member of Eramis's dark council. Once you get a hold of their Splinter, the Exo Stranger can use it to enhance your own, which will in turn strengthen your proficiency with Stasis.

But don't get carried away. You have a ways to go before you can face Eramis. Now that you've accepted Stasis, you must learn to resist the temptations of the Darkness and use it solely for the good of humanity.
With that, she hands you back your Splinter, now infused with Phylaks's, readying you for the next stage of Stasis.

Variks disapproves of your new Stasis abilities. He thinks you're being reckless. He warns you to remember what the Darkness has done and what it is doing to Eramis. He refuses to believe that this is the only way to stop her.

But he acknowledges that you are free to walk your own path, even if it's a dangerous one. He urges you not to lose sight of your goal. To get to Eramis, you must begin by defeating the leader of her army: Phylaks. Thanks to his secret communication network, Variks learned that Phylaks was ordered to take control of an area currently occupied by the Vex.
Gather information about the whereabouts of Phylaks, the Warrior by challenging her soldiers in Eventide Ruins.

Now that Eramis is defeated, the Vanguard hopes to reclaim Europa for humanity. Zavala asks your help in destabilizing what remains of House Salvation. He informs you that Variks will help guide you through your first mission: sabotaging a Fallen weapons factory on Europa.
You have discovered your Darkness within, and the threat posed by Eramis is no more. Her frozen visage will haunt the vista of Riis-Reborn for eternity.
The time has come for you to complete your journey and truly master the power of Stasis.
The Darkness beckons you to Europa. Will you answer its call?
An enhanced Splinter of Darkness that allows you to pursue and complete your journey beyond Light.

The Stranger seems pleased as you hand her the Splinter you retrieved from Praksis. You've made progress in dismantling Eramis's dark council and shown that, so far, you have a good handle on resisting the temptations of the Darkness.

But the journey's not over yet. In order to wield Stasis against the Kell of Darkness, you must achieve perfect control of the power flowing within you. The Exo Stranger has seen what happens to Guardians who lack this discipline, but refuses to explain herself just yet.
She hands you back your Splinter, now enhanced by Praksis's. You're ready for the next stage of Stasis.

You stand now at the end of this path, having learned acceptance, resistance, and control. You have wielded Stasis with skill and to good end. You have ended the dangerous reign of the Kell of Darkness.
Help Variks set up the patrols network in Charon's Crossing.
Investigate Praksis, the Technocrat's plans in Asterion Abyss.
Complete "The New Kell" mission.
Speak to Shaw Han in The Steppes.
Locate Bakris, the Adamantine and scatter the Devils before they leave for Europa. Defeat Fallen in the Cosmodrome, The Divide.
Complete "The Warrior" Empire Hunt.
Complete "The Kell of Darkness" mission.
Complete "The Technocrat" Empire Hunt.
Return to the Exo Stranger in Beyond.
Complete the "Rising Resistance" mission.
Help Variks evacuate the allied Fallen in Eventide Ruins.
Return to your camp in Beyond.
Attune your enhanced Splinter of Darkness at the Ziggurat in Beyond.
Return to Variks on Europa for more details.
A special engram for those seeking to complete their collections. It is available only once per week.
How did you get Petra to teach you this?
You can do this dance to any music.
A nostalgic dance to help one simply feel better.
It is my firm belief that you should not have done that.
A very special salute for very special Guardians.
Those in the know are in the know.
A dance for the most contest-loving of Guardians.
"These are mementos of past Awoken Paladins. I don't know how the Fallen learned of them, but a Taken attack targeted the mementos… and desecrated them."
"Our honored dead deserve better. Take their mementos into the Shattered Throne and hunt down the Taken responsible. Their blood will avenge the wrong that's been done and purify the tokens."
"As for the bow…" Petra gives you a small, almost wistful smile. "I will not ask what passed between Sjur Eido and you. Hunt well, my friend."
"The past refuses to rest peacefully here. The Taken know this as well as we do, and recent assaults targeted the very history of the Awoken."
"I won't let the Taken go unpunished. Come see me as soon as you can."
The work of the Queen's Wrath is never done and neither is that of the Guardians.
The purified Awoken mementos belong with Sjur Eido, the first Queen's Wrath. Go to her statue and present them as an offering.

Petra holds out a case full of strange mementos. Despite their small size, their antiquity is apparent—as is the Taken corruption clinging to them. Petra starts to speak, and you hear righteous anger behind her clipped words.
The bow thrums with whispers from the past. Distant and haunting, like a familar but half-forgotten melody. It is not an entirely comforting sound.
A brief message from Petra Venj, the Queen's Wrath, awaits you.
Realizing that a bad situation doesn't mean you can't have a good time.
Working together as a team to achieve victory.
Paying attention to the enemies and communicating what you see.
Take a short break, Oath Breaker.
Detect caches or resources within a 50-meter range.
Detect caches or resources within a 40-meter range.
Teaching the strategies that have worked for you.
Paying attention to each player's strengths and weaknesses and using them effectively.
Checking the modifiers and adjusting your play style or gear accordingly.
Vendors have new weekly bounties each week. They take a decent chunk of time to complete, but offer substantial rewards.
Bounties are a strong source of experience for gaining Rewards Pass ranks and Artifact levels. Bounties are available for purchase from many Tower vendors as well as your planetary contacts.
The Eververse Store features a daily rotating selection of items that can be purchased with Bright Dust instead of Silver.
Daily bounties refresh each and every day with a new selection of things to do. Try them out—they shouldn't take you long!
Commander Zavala, Lord Shaxx, and the Drifter offer shaders and emblems each Season, achievable through focused investment in their respective activities.
Commander Zavala, Lord Shaxx, and the Drifter offer themed cosmetic upgrades each Season, achievable through focused investment in their respective activites.
Once you reach the Power cap—and powerful rewards no longer give you higher Power—the only way to advance is through pinnacle rewards. You can find pinnacle challenges in the Director.
After you reach a certain Power level on your gear, most activities and items no longer grant you progress. A consistent way to advance is to complete weekly challenges that award powerful loot.
Weekly challenges show up with a special icon in the Director. They offer significant experience gains as well as powerful or pinnacle rewards.

Repeatable bounties are expensive, but offer players the ability to earn consistent experience and other rewards that focus on one activity. You can hold only five repeatable bounties from a given vendor at once.
Exotic quests are challenging pursuits that award unique and powerful weapons. Many Exotic quests can be started from vendors in the Tower, but others must be discovered in the world.
Fikrul returns, wielding an Echo with the power to twist living Eliksni to his own ends.
Step into the role of Slayer Baron, raise the banner of House Light, and wield the paracausal powers of Eido's tonics against them.
The Dreadnaught lives again and surges with Taken corruption threatening to spread throughout Sol.
You must find the resolve and ambition to repel the Taken.
Become a conduit of corrosive power—the bulwark against chaos—and break the Taken with your will.
In the aftermath of the Witness's death, explore novel paracausal mysteries.
Delve into the core of the living planet Nessus, and pursue a ruthless new threat with a familiar face.
Embark on a perilous journey into the heart of the Traveler, rally the Vanguard, and end the War of Light and Darkness.

The number of Gambit matches won this week.

Variks thanks you for helping to defend Europa. He offers you a token of his gratitude.
Visit Variks in Charon's Crossing.
Spider's got eyes all over this system. What do you wanna bet he has an inside man on Europa?
lines.speaker: The Drifter

lines.text: I got one more piece of the puzzle to give you. Then we're ready to pull this thing off.
lines.speaker: The Drifter

lines.text: "According to those blueprints, the one thing the Fallen haven't worked out yet is how to stabilize the Stasis energy. So I whipped up a prototype of my own." He winks. "This should help you get the gun firing."
I've picked up a few Fallen weapons in my time. Pretty impressive what they can do with some spare parts and grit.
lines.speaker: The Drifter

lines.text: Let's see what the Fallen managed to cook up.
lines.speaker: The Drifter

lines.text: I've got some… business to take care of. But I'll send your Ghost some notes on the area. How to get in and out real quick, no trouble.
lines.speaker: The Drifter

lines.text: Got a friend waiting for you in a Lost Sector. Might have to fight your way in first.
lines.speaker: The Drifter

lines.text: Looks like there are some cracks in the empire now that Eramis is out. We can use that.
lines.speaker: The Drifter

lines.text: With your new Skiff codes in hand, you're nearly ready to go after the Stasis weapon. First, Drifter wants to meet with you to give you a critical weapon component.
You successfully acquired the Stasis weapon from the Fallen. Drifter wants to take a look at it.

The Drifter examines the blueprints you found. Turns out that the Fallen are using Praksis's armor tech to create a weapon capable of channeling Stasis energy. Eramis had plans to distribute this weaponry to Fallen all across the system, expanding the capabilities of her army.

Drifter likes the idea so much that he immediately cooks up a plan to steal the prototype from the Fallen. He thinks Spider's associates might be able to offer some insider information too. While he looks over the blueprints and calls in a favor, he asks you to go to Europa and gather more intel on the prototype.

Drifter contacts you to let you know Spider's sending an associate to meet with you. She has some tech that will disguise your ship to appear on radar as a Skiff, letting you sneak into a back area of the city. She's waiting for you in a Lost Sector.
Team up with the Drifter to steal a Stasis weapon made by the Fallen.
You're ready to go after the Stasis weapon prototype. You've got all the tools you need to break in. All that's left to do is get the gun.
The Drifter has asked you to gather Fallen weapons intel while he inspects the blueprints you found. That might lead to more information about the Stasis weapon prototype.
You found some briefs that indicate the Stasis weapon effort is being led by a high-ranking Fallen lieutenant. Taking the lieutenant down could gain you more information about the gun's whereabouts.

You discovered intel that suggests the Stasis weapon is being held in the Fallen city. Drifter's going to find you a way in. In the meantime, practicing with Stasis will be good preparation for learning to use this experimental gun.
Drifter is impressed. He admires the gun and asks you to bring it through Gambit sometime. This weapon could really shake things up.
Complete the "Stealing Stasis" mission.
Return to Europa and complete the "Stealing Stasis" mission.
Visit Drifter in the Annex.
Visit the Drifter in the Annex.

Ever eat a fried pumpkin?
lines.speaker: Drifter

lines.text: The path you walk requires balance: between Light and Dark, life and death, truth and lies. Stay mindful.
lines.speaker: Ikora Rey

lines.text: Malice is a weapon that cuts both ways. Wield it with care.
lines.speaker: Eris Morn

lines.text: Leave no doubt in the enemy's mind. Their will is the enemy, not their body.
lines.speaker: Mithrax

lines.text: I'd be angry, too, if I had a pumpkin for a head.
lines.speaker: Glint

lines.text: Another party I'm not invited to. What a surprise.
lines.speaker: Failsafe

lines.text: The dead are the least of your problems.
lines.speaker: Drifter

lines.text: I tried talking to the Headless Ones, with no success. I now suggest violence.
lines.speaker: Failsafe

lines.text: Could I ask a favor, Guardian? Please don't destroy ALL the evidence.
lines.speaker: Glint

lines.text: Living or dead, body or no body. Titans find a way.
lines.speaker: Zavala

lines.text: Of course I can resurrect you. But I'd prefer not to be alone down here…
lines.speaker: Glint

lines.text: Team up with your clanmates and guide seekers through the raid.
Team up with your clanmates and guide seekers through the Nightfall.
Select and meet a clan to guide you through the Nightfall.
Select and meet a clan to guide you through the raid.

Uh uh. Not quite yet. The blade is only for those who can handle its power. Sure, you've proven yourself somewhat. But I'll need to see you survive one of the training modules built for Exos first. Best of luck.
lines.speaker: Clovis AI

lines.text: Lookin' like some of those flashes are of me trudging through ice and snow, passin' bodies of my fellow Exos. One of 'em looked to be surrounded by Vex technology, another amongst the ruins of an old city, and another surrounded by factory equipment. The rest are a blur… Shame I left 'em behind. Wish I knew why. Bet you might figure that out.
lines.speaker: Banshee-44

lines.text: Not sure what exactly we're looking for in that bunker. But my instinct tells me it's some way to mend that Broken Blade. Look for a bunker hidden beneath the ice. That's the best I got for ya.
lines.speaker: Banshee-44

lines.text: Those Dead Exos you found are giving me a headache something fierce—and even more flashes. That blade again, in more glory than before. Must be important. Also saw frozen-over labs filled with dormant Exos. Even saw one the size of a giant. Gonna take a guess and say that's your next stop… wherever it is.
lines.speaker: Banshee-44

lines.text: Oh, did I forget to mention it was broken? Not my problem. Perhaps this Banshee friend of yours can help. Until next time.
lines.speaker: Clovis AI

lines.text: This isn't the first time the Vex have tried to destroy me and everything I've built. I hate to admit it, but I need your help, and I need it immediately.
lines.speaker: Clovis AI

lines.text: "This thing is givin' me flashes left and right. But they're scrambled. Something about a bunker hidden away among the ice. Must be Europa. Gotta ask you to help one more time. We're close, I can feel it."
"I've got questions, and it sounds like I've also got answers. Hopefully I've got nothing left to answer for."
"Bunch of Guardians storm the Deep Stone Crypt and next thing I know, I wake up in a daze sprawled out on the floor.
lines.speaker: Banshee-44

lines.text: "Seems crazy to assume the two are connected, but then again, stranger things and all that, y'know?
lines.speaker: Banshee-44

lines.text: "Now you walk in here and my insides go haywire all over again.
lines.speaker: Banshee-44

lines.text: "Lotta weird images flashin' through my mind. Hard to make sense of 'em all. Vex… a blade… And a few dead Exos on Europa, unhappy with their lot in life, I imagine.
lines.speaker: Banshee-44

lines.text: Not sure what that's about. Maybe see about findin' 'em? Help me make sense of all this. I'll be waitin'.
lines.speaker: Banshee-44

lines.text: Last thing. I swear. There's still a number of Vex running around. Some too dangerous to leave unattended. Escort them out of this life, and I'll give you what you're after.
lines.speaker: Clovis AI

lines.text: Well then, perhaps I owe you the other side of quid pro quo. The blade you're looking for was broken into pieces somewhere in the Glassway. By now, the Vex have likely found it themselves. Someone as capable as you should have no issue retrieving it from them. Now leave me be.
lines.speaker: Clovis AI

lines.text: Seems like we have a lot to discuss. The visions haven't stopped, but I think I get it now. You know where to find me.
lines.speaker: Banshee-44

lines.text: I know you desire the blade. But you can't have it just yet. I'll need a few tasks completed first. It's been a while since I've been… awake. And now this alien race you call "Fallen" infest MY colony. They must be dealt with in short order. See to it.
lines.speaker: Clovis AI

lines.text: You really want to help your friend, Banshee? Start by eliminating any Vex you can find. They've long been more than just a pain in my side. One day, they will answer to us. Until then, see that they're dealt with.
lines.speaker: Clovis AI

lines.text: Work with Banshee to unravel the mysteries surrounding a Golden Age blade.
Use Swords to defeat Vex on any destination.
Use Swords to defeat Minotaurs, Hydras, and Cyclopes on any destination.
Locate the Giant Exo
Complete "Reforging the Past"
The stately and inscrutable ruler of the Reef.

It seems you've discovered my grandfather's Exo training protocols. They were designed to hastily upgrade the physical and mental fortitude of newly built Exos. But their design contained a rather 'dark' secret, as did most things built by my grandfather. Be careful within them; I imagine they won't play nice.
lines.speaker: The Exo Stranger

lines.text: "Old secrets emerge in the wake of your kind invading the Deep Stone Crypt. Something siphons power where it didn't before, in Bray Exoscience."
"Investigate, yes?"
"We must not give them even a single ledge from which to pull themselves up."

Though Eramis dug deep, she did not uncover every secret buried within the ice. Long before our arrival, Europa thrived through scientific discovery during your Golden Age. It is, of course, the birthplace of the Exo. Though we understand little of what that actually entails. Perhaps you may be our key to unearthing these secrets and keeping them out of the hands of House Salvation.
lines.speaker: Variks the Loyal

lines.text: You've discovered what was siphoning power from Bray Exoscience. The Exo Stranger might be interested to hear what you've learned.
The Guardians that stormed the Deep Stone Crypt inadvertently reactivated dormant power sources across Europa. Variks has detected one such power source within Bray Exoscience.
Simulated training protocols designed to upgrade newly activated Exos.
Data generated through Pinnacle Ops and Arena Ops completions.
Historical data preserved as luminous matter. Valuable to those who study humanity's past.
Take these to Master Rahool in the Tower. They can be exchanged for Glimmer.
Dawning isn't about the gifts… but they do make it a bit nicer.
lines.speaker: Eva Levante

lines.text: I can scarcely believe it! This is a Dawning miracle!
lines.speaker: Eva Levante

lines.text: Such a lovely little gift.
lines.speaker: Eva Levante

lines.text: It seems you've touched many hearts this season! I expected nothing less from you!
lines.speaker: Eva Levante

lines.text: The people of the Last City are so grateful! How wonderful!
lines.speaker: Eva Levante

lines.text: The people are giving so much. They want you to feel truly appreciated!
lines.speaker: Eva Levante

lines.text: Everyone has been chipping in. Isn't that lovely?
lines.speaker: Eva Levante

lines.text: It warms my heart to see such a display of holiday spirit!
lines.speaker: Eva Levante

lines.text: The people are struggling, but they give what they can.
lines.speaker: Eva Levante

lines.text: Oh my… this is almost too much!
lines.speaker: Eva Levante

lines.text: "You're doing so well out there," she says. "Keep lifting their spirits and there will be more to come!"
"Look at all the wonderful gifts the people of the Last City have sent you, Guardian!"
"I have always been proud of you. When things looked their worst, I knew you were out there fighting to make it right. When the Pyramids came, when the Darkness took…"
"I have always been proud of you, Guardian," she says. "Let's leave it at that."
Eva smiles as she shows you the Dawning gifts sent from the grateful people of the Last City.
Eva falls silent for a long moment, then smiles.
Return to Eva and open your presents.
Return to Eva and open your present.
Variks believes Misraaks wishes for peace. But he is young. His house is small and younger still.
lines.speaker: Variks the Loyal

lines.text: Variks and his allies will seek refuge on Earth. More Eliksni will flee House Salvation. Variks will wait. Patient.
lines.speaker: Variks the Loyal

lines.text: Variks helped allies escape Eramis. Others, like Variks, who came to Europa for peace, not war.
lines.speaker: Variks the Loyal

lines.text: Eramis was a warrior. A leader of warriors. Not equipped for peace. She knew only war for too long.
lines.speaker: Variks the Loyal

lines.text: Young though he is, Kell Misraaks represents hope to Eliksni. Hope of peace with Guardians, with humanity.
lines.speaker: Variks the Loyal

lines.text: Time will tell if House Light will change the fate of my people. No longer Fallen. Eliksni once more.
lines.speaker: Variks the Loyal

lines.text: Variks is grateful for your work on Europa. He hopes you will continue to help him as new threats arise every day.
From now on, a Europa weapon will drop from your first Lost Sector completed in the Europa Eclipsed Zone each day.
Variks is grateful for your work on Europa. He offers you a token of that gratitude.
From now on, high-stat Crystocrene armor will drop from your first weekly Empire Hunt (Heroic difficulty or higher).
From now on, Crystocrene armor will drop from your first Heroic public event in the Europa Eclipsed Zone each day.
The more you get, the more you'll see.
Complete Crucible Bounties to unlock powerful gear for purchase.
The amnesiac Lightbearer once known as Prince Uldren Sov of the Reef.
"I've looked beyond this reality," said Eris Morn, lacing her hands together in front of her face. "Beyond Light and Darkness."
"I've seen Ahamkara, slain by my own blade. I've seen time broken, and the veil of causality sundered."
"I've seen my fireteam murdered, and their phantoms manifested to torment me." Eris stared off into the middle distance. "I've seen many things I wish I could forget."
"You've really seen it all," Glint said. "And blindfolded!"
"But what if—"
"Not even once, Little Light," Eris said with finality. "Not even on the Moon. I would have remembered."
"Cayde used to tell stories about the Headless Ones," Ikora recounted with a wry smile. "He said he killed dozens of them on the Moon. The way he told it, they exploded like piñatas."
"Just promise me one thing," she said. "If you do find something, tell me. Tell everyone. Cayde would've liked that."

"Well, Glint, I wouldn't classify that as evidence per se," Cryptarch Matsuo hedged. "The spontaneous creation of similar legends in disparate cultures is a well-documented phenomenon. Even in the absence of direct communication. Some scholars call it 'simultaneous invention.'"

"For instance," he continued, "the Yetis of Himalayan folklore and the Lumbering Jacks of North American legend. Both reclusive ape-like creatures said to populate the wilderness. Or the Centaur of Greek mythology and the Sheepdog of Northern Europe. Both mythical creatures said to be hybrids of other species. Etcetera."
"I have heard tales of such creatures," Mithrax said, his deep voice resonating through the ruins. "Those with eyes of flame. Tormented by endless burning."
"Some say they were once Hive, twisted by foul experiments." He paused to take a pull from his rebreather. "Others say they were Guardians who turned to Darkness."
"Has anyone from House Light seen them?"
"Yes?" the Ghost prompted. "What about him?"
"Yes, it is so," the enormous Kell nodded. "Klyfiks is an idiot."
"Bray used the tools of the Vex, while Hive blasphemers practiced the magical art of necromancy." Her tone darkened. "Both succeeded, after a fashion."
"The early Hive experiments were done in secret, under the guidance of a powerful Wizard, whose name we'll not mention here."

"Yes," Ylaia grimaced. "The unmentionable Wizard created many abominations, using deceased and living subjects, including your unfortunate Moon miners." She steepled her fingers. "It's possible that access to these powerful 'pumpkins' were a boon to his research."
"Wow, that explains a lot," Glint marveled. "But…" he continued reluctantly, "pumpkins aren't powerful relics. They're just… fruit."
"They are indeed," Ylaia concluded direly, "the fruit of the damned."
"You're not going to make fun of him, are you?" the administrator asked with a raise of her eyebrow. "He's been through enough already."
"Just the opposite," Glint assured her. "I'm one of the few people who actually believes him!"
"Robots who believe in the Headless Ones." She shook her head. "It boggles the mind."
"I think we're sentient energy signatures, housed in a cybernetic construct," Glint said, trying not to be offended. "But I do have an internal database, if that's what you mean."
"But if it's not a glitch, then… what the hell is it?"
"How could they chop off their own heads?" Saint-14 interjected. "It makes no sense. They would die halfway through."
"Well," Glint replied, "they could have built some kind of device. A guillotine, maybe?"
"I respect your commitment to this research," Geppetto said. "But unfortunately, there's no hard evidence supporting your claims."
"Bah," Saint-14 scoffed. "People say many things. You should hear what the Eliksni say about me…" He looked at the floor and scuffed his feet. "Not everything you hear is true."
"I'm happy that you're taking time to rest," Geppetto said, bobbing encouragingly. "After everything you and Brother Crow have been through, it's well deserved. Just… don't get your hopes up."
"Oops," the AI said. "I accidentally knocked the board over. How clumsy of me."
"Well…" Glint fidgeted, inching toward the exit. "I should get back to the Guardian. We're going to visit your neighbors!"
"But come again," the AI continued, "and I'll tell you everything you want to know about the Hive necromancer who ripped the concept of Headless Ones from the Human subconscious."
"…But only if I come back to visit, right?"
"That's right," said Failsafe, smugly. "I hear that's called 'incentive.'"

"Glint! It's good to see you," Eva exclaimed. "I've been enjoying your additions to our little collection." She patted the Book of the Forgotten. "Though, it makes me sad to think of all those poor lost souls, driven mad by this or that. Even if they are just tall tales."
"Actually," Glint chirped, "the Guardian and I are close to proving once and for all that the Headless Ones are real!"
"My goodness." Eva shook her head in disbelief. "Then again, I shouldn't be surprised. This system keeps getting stranger and stranger."
"Klyfiks will tell you what he has seen, but he must receive something in return." She bobbled her head slightly, which Glint interpreted as equivalent to an eye roll. "He wants his own Sparrow."

"Just so. Klyfiks claims," she emphasized the word and paused to make her skepticism clear, "that during one of these battles, he sheltered in some ruins near the crash site. Inside, he says he saw a being with a round, bulbous head and flames for eyes."
"Tomorrow, we begin our search for the machine tower. But still, there's a nagging suspicion: is this some kind of collective glitch? Is it all just in our heads?"

"Man, they can say whatever they want. I saw what I saw," the man affirmed. He motioned to the proprietor for another pitcher. "They always tell you: report everything. No detail too small. You never know what matters most."
"Buncha bullcrap," he grumbled. "I saw what I saw."
"It had a big, smiling pumpkin head!" he shouted belligerently. "With three eyes! And purple flames shooting out of it!"
"I SAW WHAT I SAW, DAMN IT!"
"…that way, when they lit the candle, it would light up the face carved into the pumpkin!"
"It was," Glint nodded. "Humans used to put this pumpkin head all over the place. They would even paint them on their—"
"The Headless Ones," Glint encouraged her. "I'm really trying to make that name stick. I think it's pretty neat."
"They've been hanging around in those ruins for centuries," Failsafe continued brightly, "but they've never once come to say hello."
"They probably don't want to be smashed by rampaging Guardians," the AI responded dourly. "How should I know?"
"Your disingenuous compliment has been noted and appreciated," Failsafe replied, the lilt returning to her voice. "Would you like to play checkers?"
"One hundred and forty-three minutes," Glint said. "It was quite impressive. Crow can barely sleep for an hour without yelling at invisible enemies."
"The invisible enemies are the most dangerous," Ylaia responded. "Just look at Savathûn."
"Speaking of invisible enemies," Glint segued, "I wanted to ask you about a sinister group of pumpkin-headed monsters called the Headless Ones. Maybe you heard of them during your training?"
"Thanks, Failsafe!" Glint scooted into the ship, away from the prying eyes of the Vex and Fallen. "I know the Vanguard hasn't been back here in a while but—"
"Correct! It's been almost two years since you last visited, even though you promised to come back often," the AI replied. "I've since developed the emotion of betrayal, just for you!"
"Well, I'm here now." Glint tried to keep his tone light. "I was hoping you could help me with a research project?"
"Of course. I'm happy to be exploited for your gain!" Failsafe replied helpfully. And then, in a more dour tone, "Anything to break up the unending loneliness."
"I'm hoping you could tell me about the Headless Ones." Glint uploaded all the information he had to Failsafe's mainframe. "I have intel that they're around here somewhere."
"You are correct," the AI replied. "They're my neighbors! And they're the absolute worst."
"It's my turn next."
"As you can see, pumpkins featured heavily in the iconography of the time. People would paint them all over their bodies. Even in highly inconvenient locations."

Mithrax emitted a series of low clicks, which Glint took as grumbling. "Klyfiks, our engineer, says he witnessed the creatures on Nessus. But…" The enormous Kell seemed to be struggling with a translation.
She tapped her datapad and brought up the requested Hidden reports. Glint transmitted the authorization code Ikora had given him, and he received the decrypted upload seconds later.
The following audio imprint was recovered by Glint, the Ghost, during scans of an Exo production facility on Europa. Its origin remains a mystery.

The Fallen found an access point into the ruins. They hit our flank an hour ago. Dosana and Rubeen were killed in the initial blast. We fought our way to a defensible position, but it won't last long.
Murrah survived, but he's been gut-shot. Without a Ghost, he won't get through the night.
We're surrounded. Shooting our way out is no longer an option. We need orbital bombardment to cover our exit, followed by immediate medical extraction.
Skirmishes are common in the noted sectors. Neither side seems committed to territorial expansion.

I'm reluctant to report that I had another sighting in the glacial cave near Cadmus Ridge. This time, I managed to get a good look at the creature with my rangefinder. The body was unmistakably that of a Hive Knight, while the helmet (or head?) appeared to be that of a… pumpkin.
The pumpkin appeared to have a face carved into it. Three eyes and a big smiling mouth. With… flames shooting out.
I know how that sounds, so I'm submitting myself to [REDACTED] for a full psychological battery. I've instructed her to alert Ikora Rey of the results, whatever the outcome.
We're not the only ones surveying this crash site. Fallen have been pouring into the area, fighting with Vex for control of the wreckage.

For now, we've dug in to some subterranean ruins just west of the downed ship. We're covering the entrance and can hold our position so long as they don't find an access point to our flank, but there's just too many for the four of us. We'll need reinforcements if we want to secure the site.
The holographic checkers board hanging in front of him suddenly exploded into a shower of digital cubes. Murky darkness filled the Exodus Black's cabin.
Just then, a Guardian wearing a ferocious chicken mask offered Eva some candy. She politely declined.
They giggled like schoolchildren, and for a moment, all their worries were forgotten.
Had my first bout of predormital sleep paralysis last night. It was expected, given the insomnia. What I didn't expect was for it to feel so real. Now I understand why the miners are scared.
The figure standing over me was a shadow, but also solid. My mind was a hundred percent convinced it was physically present. Terrifying.
Another surprise was how familiar the shadow seemed. I had the eerie feeling that I would have recognized it, if I could have just seen its face.
Eido translated Glint's question to Klyfiks, who sprawled across his chair with an air of self-importance. The two conversed for almost a minute before Eido turned back to Glint.

Glint quickly scanned his internal database for decommissioned Sparrows and identified several old models that he thought would be to Klyfiks's liking. When Eido relayed Glint's optimism, the engineer's mandibles clicked in what the Ghost assumed was excitement.
Glint met the former Hidden agent in a sake bar called the Drunken Noodle. He had agreed to speak on the condition of anonymity and was already drunk when Glint arrived.
The bar fell silent. The man suddenly felt everyone staring.
There was a long pause as Ylaia studied the hologram Glint had projected for her.

The Tech Witch furrowed her brow, piecing together many fragments of disparate lore. "If these legendary 'pumpkins' were tools for seeing beyond the veil of death," she mused, "then it makes sense that they would become the emblem of…" She looked at Glint expectantly.
I also realized why I didn't recognize it sooner. it's because that version of me, from whatever time or dimension… he doesn't have a head.

Having reviewed your transmissions and [REDACTED] report, leadership has decided to pull you from Europa for reassignment. You are instructed to remain in camp, engage your emergency transponder, and await extraction.

Off the record: your last report has been making its way around the Tower. It's become… a bit of a joke. So, when they debrief you, just keep your mouth shut about this pumpkin nonsense. Play it off as exhaustion, an optical illusion, or whatever, and you'll be back in the field in no time.

Ylaia's eyes fluttered open as she roused herself from a trance. The Techeun had been recuperating from her time in the Ascendant Plane by completing a series of restorative meditations. No sooner had she regained her bearings than Glint scooted in front of her face.
Glint hummed noncommittally. He couldn't tell whether the Techeun was joking or not.
The Cryptarch finally located the tome he had been searching for. He put on a pair of white cotton gloves and unsealed the container.
Steady on, Guardian. You keep putting up numbers like that, and my bettors will think the Games are fixed!
lines.speaker: Prak'kesh the Bookie

lines.text: Back so soon! And upright. Hmm. Guess I should give you better odds next time, Guardian.
lines.speaker: Prak'kesh the Bookie

lines.text: "Very impressive, Guardian!"
"Oh, but first: I set this aside for you. For good luck."
"Guardian. Good to see you participating in the Guardian Games." Zavala nods approvingly. "At times like these, we could all use a reprieve."

"We'll be arranging different missions for you each week. This year, I leave it to you to decide how much of a challenge you're up for." He smiles knowingly. "Perform well and you'll win the right to light the ceremonial torches in the tower. Eva's set aside some interesting prizes."
"But they also serve to remind the people of the City that we're here for them. That they can believe in us. Do them proud, Guardian."
"In celebration of the Guardian Games, I'm introducing an addition to the Crucible this year: SUPREMACY!"
"Take down your opponents and pick up the crests they drop. You want to rack up higher scores? You want those prizes? You want the other classes to beg for mercy? Then pick. Up. Crests!"
"Of course, your opponents will be after the same thing. Get to any fallen teammates first, and steal those crests out from under them."
You Guardians are so ambitious. It's hard to keep up with all your achievements! This should help.
lines.speaker: Eva Levante

lines.text: "Welcome to the Guardian Games!" Eva greets you warmly. "I'm glad you decided to join us. Once again, Titans, Warlocks, and Hunters will all be competing against each other for yearly bragging rights."
"Now, get out there and show the other classes what you're made of," she says with mock seriousness. "May the best class win!"
Back already? Why, you hardly broke a sweat! Very impressive.
lines.speaker: Eva Levante

lines.text: "Now, enjoy yourself by earning some Medallions for your class. And maybe even bank some points for yourself," she adds, "if you're feeling sassy."
"Go show everyone what you can do, and have fun!"
Are you going out to do some strikes, Guardian? Don't forget to bring a snack… and a sword!
lines.speaker: Eva Levante

lines.text: "I see you've earned your first Medallion!" Eva's eyes twinkle with delight. "This is just the first of many."

"Here's a little something to hold all of your trophies," she says, handing you a Medallion Case. "Now you'll be able to track all of your class contributions and look back on your achievements with pride."
"You're off to a great start," Eva encourages you, "but there's still plenty you can do!"
"The more Medallions you turn in, the more you'll help you class," she adds, "and the better individual rewards you'll earn."
"Track your weekly contributions so you know how close you are to your next reward threshold. Now go have fun with your friends," she encourages, "and earn some Medallions for your class!"
A lot of smart money is coming in behind you, Guardian. Seems like you got plenty of fans out there. Let's give them something to cheer about!
lines.speaker: Prak'kesh the Bookie

lines.text: Back to the Tower, eh? Do me a favor. If you see Commander Zavala, just… don't mention my name.
lines.speaker: Prak'kesh the Bookie

lines.text: I like a Guardian who's willing to bet on themselves.
lines.speaker: Prak'kesh the Bookie

lines.text: Oh, I'm always rooting for you, Guardian. Surest bet in the system.
lines.speaker: Spider

Eliksni once made marvels to rival your Golden Age. When you fight them, you do not just fight scavengers… but inventors. Creators. Architects.
lines.speaker: Variks the Loyal

lines.text: Variks heard Praksis whisper in Eramis's ear. He wished to use the Vex. To reassemble their parts into new technology.
lines.speaker: Variks the Loyal

lines.text: Praksis kept his secrets close. Variks was not permitted to know the ways of his inventions…
lines.speaker: Variks the Loyal

lines.text: You make more than a dent in House Salvation with your actions. Praksis learned this the hard way.
lines.speaker: Variks the Loyal

lines.text: Praksis's ambitions are wide. He is drawn to the design of the Vex… to the inventions of humanity… He will use anything he can find.
lines.speaker: Variks the Loyal

lines.text: Praksis admires the Vex. He seeks to use them to improve Eliksni technology. Variks does not know how.
lines.speaker: Variks the Loyal

lines.text: His creations… they mean more to Praksis than anything. They are his legacy. He will not surrender them easily.
lines.speaker: Variks the Loyal

lines.text: The Servitor you destroyed was in communication with Praksis, and Ghost is now able to identify his location. You must find and defeat him.
You've defeated Praksis, the Technocrat. You should tell Variks about your victory.
Variks informs you that enemy Fallen are collecting resources for Praksis for an unknown experiment. He wants you to disrupt Praksis's plans.
Ghost is now able to locate Praksis's latest experiment. He has created an artificial Vex conflux to lure and trap the Vex. If you disrupt his experiment, Praksis might show himself.
Variks informs you that Praksis's latest experiment involves the Vex. He attached a tracking device to some of them. By retrieving those tracking devices, you should get a lead on his location.
Variks is thrilled you defeated Praksis. House Salvation continues to topple thanks to you.
Variks believes Praksis is experimenting on the Vex. He wants you to destroy Vex to disrupt Praksis's plans.

Doesn't matter how dark the place is. With someone watching your six, it'll feel like a midday stroll.
lines.speaker: Suraya Hawthorne

lines.text: The Crucible is a privilege granted by your Ghost. Honor it.
lines.speaker: Suraya Hawthorne

lines.text: I know this is ironic coming from me, but you don't have to do everything alone.
lines.speaker: Suraya Hawthorne

lines.text: The Vanguard has no shortage of assignments. What catches your eye?
lines.speaker: Suraya Hawthorne

lines.text: Don't forget to leave some for your buddies.
lines.speaker: Suraya Hawthorne

lines.text: Lots of talk in the Tower about who the best is. Go make your case.
lines.speaker: Suraya Hawthorne

lines.text: You wanna pick a side? You've already lost. There's no winning in the world of Light and Dark. Just surviving.
lines.speaker: The Drifter

lines.text: The Stranger knows a thing or two, sure. But if she thinks the bad things waiting in our future can be stopped? She's got her eyes closed to reality.
lines.speaker: The Drifter

lines.text: No matter what that Stranger and Eris say, I'm gonna be ready for what comes. You oughta follow my lead.
lines.speaker: The Drifter

lines.text: A little Light, a little Dark. If you wanna make it in this world, you gotta be flexible.
lines.speaker: The Drifter

lines.text: Defeat Caiatl's Chosen aboard the Land Tank, Halphas Electus, on Nessus.

Emperor Calus, disgraced former leader of the Cabal, enticed Guardians back to his Leviathan ship with promises of power, all in the hopes that he could sway them to his clandestine ranks as a Shadow.
The Guardians competed in Calus's Menagerie and claimed their spoils, but their allegiances remained steadfast.
Guardians met Ada-1, reclusive Exo and curator of the weapon foundry called The Black Armory. Though distrustful of Lightbearers, Ada needed help to recover her Forges, lost during the Red War.
Guardians recovered all four Armory forges and unearthed secrets of Ada's own past, rekindling the Armory's operations and changing Ada's outlook on those who wield the Light.
The Drifter upped the ante on his Gambit, much to the Vanguard's disappointment. Guardians made a choice, to spy on the Drifter or to work more closely with him.
Guardians learned bits of Drifter's past: that the Nine are patrons of his endeavors, and that he knew their Emissary days past, when both were different people.
In a high-stakes prison escape, Uldren Sov and his eight Barons took out legendary Hunter, Cayde-6, and unleashed chaos across the Reef. Avenge the fallen Vanguard leader at any cost.
Uncover the mysteries at the heart of the Dreaming City, earn a wealth of new Exotic weapons, and carry the Light into the Shattered Throne dungeon and Last Wish raid.
A tactical hub used by the Vanguard to combat the system's greatest threats.
The essence of one weapon becomes the strength of the next.
lines.speaker: Eris Morn

lines.text: "These are rare materials that only manifest in specific areas of conflict. While Banshee and I can provide this material to Guardians, our supplies are quite limited. If you need larger quantities of these Alloys, you will need to seek out these conflict zones."
A shape formed; a memory reconstituted.
lines.speaker: Eris Morn

lines.text: A repeat performance? Or a variation on a theme?
lines.speaker: Eris Morn

lines.text: Only through great challenge can we reap great rewards.
lines.speaker: Ikora Rey

lines.text: You have the raw materials. What more can you glean?
lines.speaker: Eris Morn

lines.text: Like a reverberating echo, these materials resound with significance from long ago.
lines.speaker: Eris Morn

"Guardian," Eva intones, face backlit with the flickering light of holiday candles. "Listen now to my tale of vengeance and woe!"

"I arranged Mystery Grab Bags to give everyone an exciting and meaningful Festival of the Lost. And now some of them have gone missing! I suspect someone hungry, lurking around in a basement… if you catch my DRIFT."
"I see you're ready for the Festival with a very official mask of your own. In the spirit of the season, I'd appreciate if you found the culprit and gave them a good scare."
She waggles her outspread fingers, making the shadows around her dance. But her tone is serious.
"Perhaps for the best for their digestion and my carpets, Eva's bags had no candy within. But the local ramen shop had a sack of corn to spare! Much better for their little pigeon bellies."
As you approach Saint-14, you notice a suspiciously large number of well-fed pigeons have gathered around him, all cooing at top volume.
You stay silent, hoping Saint-14 doesn't recognize you under the mask. With an awkward salute, you leave him to clean up after his birds.
